modmenu.descriptionTranslation.modlangco: Create, edit, and apply local community translations for your installed mods through Mod Menu.

modlangcollective.editor.translate_not_s: No language scan is available for this entry.
modlangcollective.editor.help_steps:
1. Choose a language
Use Add language to start. Original shows the source texts without changing them.

2. Translate and confirm
Choose a text, type your translation, then use Confirm to save it. Save can confirm all texts you have edited; untouched texts stay untranslated.

3. Use your translations
Select the same language in Minecraft. Reopen a mod screen if it still shows the old text.

Manage a language
Hover over its name to reset or remove it. Discard changes restores its saved text. These actions ask before changing your work.
